title: Energy boost for an irregular partition
difficulty_reason: The new obligation is to construct one common refinement using all witnesses of irregularity simultaneously, preserving each witnessed pair-energy gain in the final single partition. The author aligns the off-diagonal witnesses by symmetry, retains two possibly different diagonal witnesses, obtains at most k+1cutting sets in each original part and hence at most2^(k+1)subparts. The proof then transfers all local epsilon^4weighted gains through monotonicity to the same refinement and aggregates the irregular-pair mass to a global gain>epsilon^5. A sequential choice of newly irregular pairs does not preserve this guarantee; the supplied simultaneous witness construction is the non-routine structural step. Variance, convexity and summation alone are ordinary prerequisites and their complete source proofs are included. This quantitative one-step lemma has a prescribed initial partition and an explicit refinement/energy conclusion, different from the already selected regularity-existence claims. H2 is proposed on that actual construction and proof, not on age, naming, or proof completeness.
